title: ImageDigest and ImageReference
description: Normative string formats for worker images (CF20, CF21, Sprut invariant 3; docs/images-and-ownership.md). The schema itself validates an ImageReference. ImageDigest is `sha256:` plus 64 lowercase hex digits. ImageReference is `<repository>@<ImageDigest>`; there is no tag form and no tag+digest form (`repo:tag@sha256:...` is rejected). The repository is fully qualified with an explicit registry host that contains a dot and has no port (`ghcr.io/alexindacomp/sprut-worker`), so no implicit Docker Hub resolution can apply. Images are pulled and run only by ImageReference, and every run (smoke test, worker, diagnostic) uses an explicit no-pull mode (`docker run --pull=never`, or the Go SDK equivalent: create without pulling); a missing image is a PLAN_STALE / re-plan, never an implicit download. The definitions in $defs are copied verbatim into the schemas that use them; tools/validate.py checks that the copies are identical.

image_digest.description: ImageDigest: content digest of an image manifest, `sha256:` plus 64 lowercase hex digits. Compared as a string.

repository.description: Fully qualified repository: a registry host with at least one dot (lowercase, no port), then one or more lowercase path components separated by `/`; components use `.`, `_`, `-` only between alphanumerics. At most 255 characters.

image_reference.description: ImageReference: `<repository>@<ImageDigest>`, the only form passed to the engine. Its digest part is the identity used by the allowlist and the consented plan.
